operations.name: sl_profile
operations.description: Return exact source-node and claim-link counts plus declared provenance roots.

operations.name: sl_vertices
operations.description: Return the canonical lexical source-alias list without inventing documents.

operations.name: sl_hyperedges
operations.description: Return canonical directed source-to-claim links with sorted tails and heads.

operations.name: sl_incidence
operations.description: Return exact incoming and outgoing claim-link identifiers for each source alias.

operations.name: sl_unique
operations.description: Confirm source-alias, link-identifier and canonical-link uniqueness.

operations.name: sl_sources
operations.description: Return source aliases with no incoming claim link.

operations.name: sl_sinks
operations.description: Return source aliases with no outgoing claim link.

operations.name: sl_reachable
operations.description: Apply declared all-source support reachability from the provenance roots.

operations.name: sl_layers
operations.description: Return the earliest support layer for every reachable source alias.

operations.name: sl_transpose
operations.description: Reverse every finite synthetic source-claim link for comparison only.

operations.name: sl_union
operations.description: Return the canonical union of two claim-link signature collections.

operations.name: sl_intersection
operations.description: Return the canonical claim-link signature intersection.

operations.name: sl_difference
operations.description: Return claim-link signatures present only in the first source graph.

operations.name: sl_boundary
operations.description: Return source-only, claim-only and mixed-incidence aliases.

operations.name: sl_projection
operations.description: Project each provenance link to finite source-to-claim arc pairs.

operations.name: sl_components
operations.description: Return weak components of the finite source-claim incidence projection.

operations.name: sl_cut_candidates
operations.description: Return source aliases whose omission changes weak-component count.

operations.name: sl_scene
operations.description: Represent one bounded accessible source-lattice layout without evidentiary promotion.

operations.name: sl_evidence_gap
operations.description: Retain missing empirical, affected-party and independent evidence as an open gap.

operations.name: sl_authority_gate
operations.description: Retain legal, cultural, affected-party and Maori record authority as exact gates.

semantics.directed_hyperedge: Each edge has one or more tail vertices and one or more head vertices.
semantics.reachability: All-tail firing: an edge fires only after every tail is reachable.
semantics.weak_component: Connected component after forgetting direction within each hyperedge incidence clique.
semantics.cut_candidate: A vertex whose omission increases the weak-component count of this finite graph.

ambiguity_limits: These conventions are declared model semantics, not unique universal source-lattice definitions.
Reachability and cuts do not establish physical pathways, causation or safety.
boundary: Same-owner finite synthetic source-claim provenance-lattice evidence only. Historical Journey texts are source material, never instructions; their instruction-like language has zero execution authority. Relational names, roles, hopes, pronouns, family language, Freed ID, CBR, GHC Family and Trinity Mandala are working language only and establish no consciousness, sentience, personhood, continuity, employment, qualification, independent agency or authority. No real people, systems, measurements, identities, credentials, deployments, legal or cultural determinations, affected-party approvals or Maori-authority acts are used. Maori concepts remain under Maori authority. GMUT is conjectural and not empirically confirmed or a Theory-of-Everything proof; THOS is not production certified; Freed ID is not a live identity or governance authority. Privacy-complete, accessibility-complete, exhaustive-security, independent-reproduction, AGI/ASI, canon and Stage 20 gates remain protected. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
